newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo central bank leaves discount rate unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Yugo central bank leaves discount rate unchanged.

text.p: The Yugoslav central bank on Monday decided to leave its key discount rate for October unchanged at 4.5 percent per month, a central bank official said.
"The bank based its decision on stable monetary developments," the official who asked not to be named told Reuters.

This was the fifth consecutive month that the National Bank of Yugoslavia (NBY) kept its discount rate at the same level -- the equivalent of 68.15 percent a year. -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 222 4254
